svg.title: VPN headend sizing arithmetic including N minus one capacity, and the five dimensions that each produce a different number
svg.desc: Left: the arithmetic starts with three thousand concurrent users at two megabits per second each, giving six gigabits per second of payload; nominal throughput multiplied by 0.4 for encryption, small packets and features gives actual throughput, so six gigabits divided by 0.4 requires fifteen gigabits nominal, meaning at least two fifteen-gigabit units. The N minus one rule says remaining capacity after a single failure must still cover peak demand rather than the sum of both units, so two times fifteen is a floor and not a target. Small packets from video conferencing at two to four hundred bytes hit packets per second first, features such as IPS, anti-virus and decryption halve the numbers one by one, and the headend is a single point because it carries every user rather than a link. Right: five dimensions with five different numbers - encrypted throughput at 0.3 to 0.5 of nominal, concurrent sessions and tunnels as a hardware ceiling rather than a licence figure, new connections per second set by the nine o'clock login storm, availability through N plus one and multiple client entry points, and experience through local breakout rather than full tunnelling.
svg.text: A VPN headend is a capacity and state problem wearing an encryption costume
The licence says 5 Gbps. The datasheet says 5 Gbps. Neither number is the number your users will experience at 09:00.
THE ARITHMETIC THAT DECIDES THE PURCHASE
并发用户 3,000 x 每用户 2 Mbps = 6 Gbps 有效负载
标称吞吐 x 0.4（加密 + 小包 + 特性）= 实测吞吐
6 Gbps / 0.4 = 15 Gbps 标称 -> 至少 2 x 15 Gbps
N-1 规则
单台故障后剩余容量仍要 >= 峰值需求，
而不是“两台加起来够”
所以 2 x 15 是最低，不是目标
小包最伤：视频会议 200-400 byte 包，PPS 先到顶
特性最伤：IPS + 反病毒 + 解密 逐项折半
头端是单点：它挂的不是链路，是所有人
FIVE DIMENSIONS, FIVE DIFFERENT NUMBERS
Dimension
What to actually size
吞吐（加密后）
并发会话 / 隧道
平台硬上限，不是许可数
每秒新建连接 CPS
09:00 同时上线决定
可用性
N+1 + 客户端多入口
体验
就近接入 + 分流（非全隧道）
分流：办公流量直出（DIA），只有内网流量回隧道
What the acceptance test must show
Log every concurrent user in within a five-minute window, measure encrypted throughput with the real feature set enabled, fail one headend
and measure how long the reconnection takes, then repeat with one exit unavailable. Without these three numbers the headend is unmeasured.
The purchase mistake: sizing on the datasheet maximum, then enabling IPS and finding the peak is served at 40 percent of it.
